findingDetails.title: Spec Files to Change does not authorize the generated artifacts the diff carries
findingDetails.case: An auditor diffs the two commits against spec.md and finds the Hermes mirror and both activation manifests changed with no row that authorizes or explains them.
findingDetails.evidence: The Files to Change table lists four paths; git diff --name-only d99ddaff7d..1895122d37 returns seven, adding the generated Hermes mirror and the two compiled-routing activation manifests, which carry the same re-minted policy hash in both copies.
findingDetails.scopeProof: All three unlisted paths are generated or gate-driven and the two manifests are identical twins; no authored file is absent from the table.
findingDetails.userImpact: A reader of the phase packet cannot distinguish authored changes from gate-generated ones; a later audit may read them as unexplained scope.
findingDetails.recommendation: Add the three generated paths to the Files to Change table with a Regenerated / gate-driven change type, as phase 003 review did.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: If the packet template convention excludes gate-generated artifacts from Files to Change, this collapses to noise.
